import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_68/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_68/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Step 1: JOIN Source2_68_0 and Source2_68_1 on "school_name"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner", suffixes=('_0', '_1'))

# Step 2: GROUP BY Source2_68_0.school_name, Source2_68_0.type
# Aggregations:
#   sum(Source2_68_0.size) as Total Students
#   sum(Source2_68_0.budget) as Total School Budget
#   avg(Source2_68_1.math_score) as Average Math Score
#   avg(Source2_68_1.reading_score) as Average Reading Score

grouped = df_joined.groupby(['school_name', 'type'], as_index=False).agg(
    Total_Students=pd.NamedAgg(column='size', aggfunc='sum'),
    Total_School_Budget=pd.NamedAgg(column='budget', aggfunc='sum'),
    Average_Math_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column='math_score', aggfunc='mean'),
    Average_Reading_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column='reading_score', aggfunc='mean')
)

# Rename columns to match exactly the target schema column names
grouped.rename(columns={
    'Total_Students': 'Total Students',
    'Total_School_Budget': 'Total School Budget',
    'Average_Math_Score': 'Average Math Score',
    'Average_Reading_Score': 'Average Reading Score'
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure data types match target schema:
# 'school_name': string
# 'type': string
# 'Total Students': integer
# 'Total School Budget': integer
# 'Average Math Score': float
# 'Average Reading Score': float

grouped['school_name'] = grouped['school_name'].astype(str)
grouped['type'] = grouped['type'].astype(str)
grouped['Total Students'] = grouped['Total Students'].round(0).astype(int)
grouped['Total School Budget'] = grouped['Total School Budget'].round(0).astype(int)
grouped['Average Math Score'] = grouped['Average Math Score'].astype(float)
grouped['Average Reading Score'] = grouped['Average Reading Score'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_68/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

        'Average Math Score': ('math_score', 'mean'),

    }
)
